title: First installment and start of an HMO continence payment plan: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
A payment plan for the balance of a Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program may open with a first installment, or may start a month later. The form depends on the customer's payment-plan history on their Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program and on their recent payments.

## Form of the plan

1. **A withdrawn CGM plan.** When a payment plan request the customer made on their Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program was received within the last 24 calendar months and now stands withdrawn, a first installment is set. It is a quarter (0.25) of the covered balance, rounded to the nearest cent. It is billed on the next statement and is not one of the installments recorded on the plan. It is taken from the amount spread, and one month is taken off the installments recorded on the plan.
2. **A recent payment.** When there is no such withdrawn plan, and the customer made a payment on the continence program within the last 30 calendar days, the plan starts a month later and one month is taken off the installments recorded on the plan.
3. **Otherwise** nothing changes.

A payment plan request is within the last 24 calendar months when it was received fewer than 24 whole calendar months before the plan is accepted. A payment is within the last 30 calendar days when it is posted no more than 30 calendar days before.

## Input, judgement and form (hypothetical; covered balance 480.00 USD, 8 installments before this rule)

| CGM plan request received within 24 months and now withdrawn | Continence payment within 30 days | First installment | Amount spread | Installments recorded |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | 120.00 USD, a quarter of 480.00 | 360.00 USD | 7 |
| no | yes, 30 days ago | none | 480.00 USD | 7, with the plan starting a month later |
| no | yes, 31 days ago | none | 480.00 USD | 8 |
| no | no | none | 480.00 USD | 8 |
